authoring_rules: Use only the frozen retrieval-active corpus for the corresponding use case.
Do not use B0/B1/G1 outputs, benchmark results, diagnostic rankings, or performance to select, rewrite, remove, or reclassify tasks.
Direct-retrieval tasks require localized evidence from one required document.
Within-document tasks require material synthesis across at least two evidence locations in one document.
Cross-document tasks require evidence from at least two required documents.
Insufficient-evidence tasks require a separate corpus-wide absence audit.
Reference answers and evidence require human verification before freeze.
Gold information must remain inaccessible to runtime.

authoring_chronology.action: Inspect only the frozen corpus and identify a realistic document-based information need.
Draft the candidate question and intended task type.
Draft a minimal reference-answer candidate from frozen source content.
Bind required documents and exact evidence through direct source inspection.
For insufficient-evidence candidates, perform a corpus-wide absence audit before acceptance.
Perform schema, source-traceability, task-type, ambiguity, duplication, and gold-leakage validation.
Conduct researcher/human review, permitting only documented pre-freeze corrections based on source/design quality.
Mark human_verified only after explicit researcher approval.
Perform final validation and cryptographic freeze before any benchmark execution.

nontrivial_task_rule.requirement: Primary benchmark tasks must represent realistic document-based information needs and MUST NOT consist only of document identity lookup, document-title lookup, legal/reference citation lookup, or trivial metadata lookup.
nontrivial_task_rule.technical_answerability_is_not_sufficien: Simple lookup of a title/reference/name alone is not sufficient merely because it is technically answerable.
nontrivial_task_rule.direct_retrieval_requirement: Direct_retrieval tasks may still use localized evidence but must ask for substantive document content.

historical_prospective_boundary.uc2_prior_qualification: UC2 T011-T020 had already undergone candidate evidence audits, task-type checks, ambiguity review, explicit researcher approval, gold-isolation validation and cryptographic freeze before this amendment.
historical_prospective_boundary.governing_scope: UC3 candidate authoring and subsequent primary-benchmark task authoring.
historical_prospective_boundary.inherited_metadata_interpretation: base_commit retains the v0.1 historical design base. status remains frozen_before_task_authoring for the prospective governing scope; this amendment does not claim to precede UC2 authoring. amendment_base_commit identifies the actual current repository state.
